in_hebrew.name: Amoakuh
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my protector
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Amoakuh הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In the Akan language of Ghana, Amoakuh means 'God is my protector'. This name is deeply rooted in the Christian faith, symbolizing the divine protection and care of the Almighty God.

in_greek.name: Amoakuh

in_latin.name: Amoakuh
in_latin.meaning: Part of, with, valley, covenant, or binding relationship
in_latin.long_meaning: Amoakuh, a name derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifies a connection or bond between individuals or communities. In Latin, the name Amoakuh represents a part of something greater, emphasizing the idea of unity and togetherness. In Christian tradition, the name Amoakuh is associated with the concept of covenant and binding relationships, highlighting the importance of commitment and loyalty.
